Thanks, agreed. That case is fixed in #400 (d5b67a1): `instructions` is now read before the `prompt` fallback and added as a system message even when `input` is omitted or null, with tests for both paths and for privacy mode. This branch is rebased onto #400's head (7cddca6), so its own change is only the max_completion_tokens commit plus its changeset; the #400 commits will drop out of this diff once #400 merges. PostHogOpenAIHandlerTests passes 36/36.

Merged `main` into the PR branch after #400 landed. The PR diff contains the `max_completion_tokens` mapping, its regression test, and its changeset.
